clue.text: Something lumpy regularly blocking gun barrel

indicators.note: regularly says take every other letter of the words gun barrel, starting with the first

explanation.surface: Some lumpy object is obstructing the barrel of a gun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' picks the 1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th and 9th letters of 'gun barrel'; 'blocking' only joins wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A gnarl is a knot or knobbly swelling on a tree trunk, so it is a lumpy thing.

clue.text: Bird's responsibility to swallow endless fruit

indicators.note: to swallow means the responsibility word takes the shortened fruit inside it

parts.note: guilt is culpability, responsibility for wrongdoing

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is dropped from the fruit

parts.note: a lemon is a fruit

explanation.surface: A bird is responsible for swallowing a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The guillemot is a black-and-white seabird of the auk family.

clue.text: Book that's white printing unit brought out

indicators.note: brought out means the printing unit is removed from the white

parts.note: albumen is the white of an egg
an en is a printer's measure of width

explanation.surface: A book with a white cover released by a printing works.
explanation.definitionFit: An album is a blank book for keeping photographs or stamps.

clue.text: Being bookish, runs into reality unexpectedly

indicators.note: into means the runs letter goes inside the rearranged reality
unexpectedly suggests the letters of reality turn up in a surprising order

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A studious person collides with the real world.
explanation.walkthrough: R goes into an anagram of REALITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Literary describes a person fond of books and reading, so bookish.

clue.text: Game and dance followed by drink at the bar?

indicators.note: followed by places the drink after the dance in the answer

parts.note: to hop is to dance, as in a hop meaning an informal dance
Scotch whisky is a drink ordered at a bar

explanation.surface: A night out: some dancing, then a whisky at the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: The children's playground game of hopping through chalked squares is a familiar example of a game.

clue.text: Gardener gets mass dropping from pigeon

indicators.note: dropping from means the mass letter is taken out of the pigeon

parts.note: a homer is a homing pigeon
M is the abbreviation for mass in physics

explanation.surface: A gardener is hit by a pigeon's mess.
explanation.definitionFit: One who works soil with a hoe is a gardener, by the agent-noun sense of the word.

clue.text: Mean person's advice to indulge in sexual harassment?

definitions.meaning: a miser who will not spend even a coin

definitions.text: advice to indulge in sexual harassment?
definitions.meaning: read as an instruction to grope a woman called Penny

explanation.definitionFit: A pinchpenny is a skinflint who pinches every coin; read as two words it tells you to pinch a woman named Penny.

clue.text: Secret clubs not hidden away

parts.note: C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs
overt means open, not concealed

explanation.surface: Secret clubs operate in the open.
explanation.definitionFit: Covert means concealed or done in secret, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Islander raving when covered in nasty ants

indicators.note: covered in means the madness sits inside the rearranged ants
nasty suggests the letters of ants are mangled into a different order

parts.note: raving as a noun is madness, mania

explanation.surface: An islander goes mad when swarmed by biting ants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nasty' scrambles the clue's ants to TASN, and 'covered in' puts the madness inside that run.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tasmanian is a native of Tasmania, the island state of Australia.

clue.text: Gosh! -—- getting hold of Bible must be serious!

indicators.note: getting hold of means the exclamation grips the Bible letters inside it

parts.note: hey is an exclamation of surprise like gosh
AV is the Authorised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims at the seriousness of grabbing a Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy can mean grave or serious, as in a heavy conversation.

clue.text: Venture we start to explore in pub with intermediary

indicators.note: in places the bet, we and the opening letter inside the pub

parts.note: an inn is a pub
to bet is to venture or stake money

indicators.note: start to means only the opening letter of the word explore is wanted

explanation.surface: Someone proposes an exploratory venture, with a middleman, in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in-between sits in the middle, which is what an intermediary does.

clue.text: Panorama is a TV broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast suggests scattering, so the letters of is a TV are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: Panorama, the BBC current-affairs programme, is a TV show that gets broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: Panorama is a long-running BBC documentary series, which makes the surface read as a statement about television.
explanation.definitionFit: A vista is a wide view, which is a synonym for a panorama.

clue.text: Primates slumber uneasily but not bishop

indicators.note: uneasily signals that the remaining letters are rearranged into a restless new order
but not tells us to remove the bishop's letter from slumber

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Monkeys sleep fitfully, though a bishop does not.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing B from SLUMBER leaves SLUMER, which 'uneasily' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemurs are small tree-dwelling primates native to Madagascar.

clue.text: Shop not at all slow to limit suffering

indicators.note: to limit means the pacy word encloses the suffering, bounding it on both sides

parts.note: pacy means fast, the opposite of slow
harm is injury or suffering

explanation.surface: A store that acts quickly to reduce people's suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: A pharmacy is a chemist's shop that dispenses medicines.

clue.text: Against probing ingenious bridge design

indicators.note: probing means the against word pushes inside the ingenious word

parts.note: clever means ingenious
anti means against

explanation.surface: An opponent examines a clever bridge design.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantilever bridge uses arms anchored at one end only, a standard bridge design.

clue.text: Worker going under is full of fear — one knows what he is thinking

definitions.text: one knows what he is thinking

indicators.note: is full of means the worker's word holds the fear inside it

parts.note: a miner works underground
dread is fear

explanation.surface: A miner, frightened to go underground, meets someone who reads his thoughts.
explanation.definitionFit: A telepath who reads minds knows what another person is thinking, which the definition describes.

clue.text: Short distance covered by binmen must be made longer!

definitions.text: Short distance covered by binmen must be made longer!

parts.words: Short distance covered by binmen must be made longer!
parts.note: a tiny unit of length, a billionth of a metre, joked about as the paltry stretch refuse collectors walk on their round

explanation.surface: Complaint that refuse collectors cover too little ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A nanometre is a billionth of a metre, an extremely short distance.

clue.text: Holy army, one against invading destroyer

indicators.note: invading puts the one and against letters inside the army

parts.note: SA is the Salvation Army, a Christian organisation run along military lines
I is the Roman numeral one
V is short for versus, against

explanation.surface: A religious army fights invaders, one destroyer against them.
explanation.definitionFit: In Hinduism Siva (Shiva) is the god known as the destroyer within the trinity of creator, preserver and destroyer.

clue.text: Final word reduction — mark in that correction

parts.note: amen is said at the end of a prayer

indicators.note: in means the mark letter goes inside the reduction

parts.note: a dent is a reduction, as in a dent in profits
M is the abbreviation for mark, the old German currency

explanation.surface: Someone corrects the closing word of a draft by marking a cut.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment is a change made to correct or improve a text.

clue.text: In Greece a plain girl gets upset with those people around

indicators.note: around means those people surround the reversed girl

parts.note: they means those people

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the girl's word upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A plain-looking Greek girl is upset by people crowding round her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns the girl backwards, which suits a down clue, before 'around' puts those people round her.
explanation.definitionFit: Thessaly is the region of central Greece that consists largely of a great fertile plain.

clue.text: Fashion set by good Chinese society

indicators.note: set by places the letter for good beside the fashion word

parts.note: ton is fashion or high style, from French

explanation.surface: A style is launched by a respectable Chinese club.
explanation.definitionFit: A tong is a Chinese secret society or association, especially among émigrés in America.

clue.text: Gen on sheet prepared for heritage site

indicators.note: prepared suggests the letters of Gen on sheet are made ready in a new order

explanation.surface: Information printed on a sheet is got ready for visitors to a historic site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gen' is British slang for information; here it is just letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The prehistoric stone circle on Salisbury Plain is a World Heritage Site.

clue.text: A new hideout outside the area or within range?

indicators.note: outside means the hideout surrounds the area letter

parts.note: a den is a hideout

explanation.surface: Is a new hideaway outside the zone or inside the boundary?
explanation.walkthrough: A + N + DE(A)N. The 'range' is a mountain range, the Andes.
explanation.definitionFit: Andean means of the Andes, so something Andean lies within that South American mountain range.

clue.text: Tribal people -see them at home tucking into fish

indicators.note: tucking into means the them and home pieces go inside the fish

parts.note: sole is a flatfish
'em is a short form of them
in means at home

explanation.surface: A tribe, seen at home eating fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' just points the solver to the wordplay that follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The Seminole are a Native American nation of Florida and Oklahoma, a tribal people.

clue.text: NW town's volume of business

definitions.meaning: Sale is a town in north-west England, near Manchester, so its possessive gives the letters

explanation.definitionFit: Sales is the total quantity sold, the volume of business; Sale's is the possessive of a Greater Manchester town.

clue.text: Assassin given huge pile of notes, pounds to be pocketed

parts.note: OS is outsize, a clothing size meaning huge

indicators.note: to be pocketed means the pounds go inside the wad

parts.note: a wad is a bundle of banknotes
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A hired killer is paid a big bundle of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Lee Harvey Oswald was the assassin of President John F Kennedy in 1963.

clue.text: Female rescuers who travel to collect fool

indicators.note: to collect means the rescuers take the fool inside

parts.note: the AA, the Automobile Association, rescues broken-down motorists
a nit is a fool

explanation.surface: Roadside rescuers pick up an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: The AA is the British breakdown-recovery service, whose patrols travel to rescue stranded drivers.
explanation.definitionFit: Anita is a female first name, so the clue's 'Female' points to a woman's name.

clue.text: Frame that's hard work, any number not being potted

indicators.note: not being potted means the number letter is left out, a snooker image of a ball not sinking

parts.note: grind is laborious work
N stands for any number in mathematics

explanation.surface: A frame of snooker is hard work when no ball goes in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frame' and 'potted' suggest snooker, but the definition is a framework of bars.
explanation.definitionFit: A grid is a framework of crossing bars, a kind of frame.

clue.text: Not finishing the second coffee

indicators.note: not finishing means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: the latter is the second of two things mentioned

explanation.surface: Someone leaves their second cup of coffee unfinished.
explanation.definitionFit: A latte is an espresso coffee made with plenty of steamed milk.

clue.text: Resourceful monarch didn't stand having the ignoble around

indicators.note: around means the ignoble word wraps round the monarch and sat

parts.note: vile means base or ignoble
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the monarch
sat is the opposite of stood

explanation.surface: A clever king refused to stand, being surrounded by base people.
explanation.definitionFit: Versatile means adaptable to many tasks, a close synonym of resourceful.

clue.text: Abnormally energised and angry

indicators.note: abnormally suggests the letters of energised are arranged in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Someone is unusually wound up and cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing red is an idiom for becoming very angry, from the red cape that is said to enrage a bull.

clue.text: You put on a stone — that'll create ferment

indicators.note: put on places the stone letters after the earlier pieces

parts.note: ye is an old form of you
ST is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight of 14 pounds

explanation.surface: A warning to a dieter that they have gained a stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Yeast is the fungus that causes fermentation in brewing and baking, so it creates ferment.
